report:
Brain, right frontal lesion, stereotactic biopsy

Two smear preparations are made from the tissue. They show a fibrillary glial background traversed by elongated hyperchromatic nuclei with fine cytoplasmic processes. Sections show three pieces of tissue comprising a diffusely infiltrating astrocytic neoplasm in which atypical glial cells with elongated hyperchromatic nuclei permeate the cortex and white matter. The tumour shows increased cellularity, nuclear atypia and mitotic activity. Mitoses number 4 per 10 high-power fields. On immunohistochemistry, the tumour cells are positive for GFAP and IDH1 R132H, with ATRX lost and p53 overexpressed. The Ki-67 proliferation index is approximately 12 per cent. On molecular testing, an IDH mutation is detected, 1p and 19q are retained and there is homozygous deletion of CDKN2A/B.

BRAIN, right frontal lobe, stereotactic biopsy - ASTROCYTOMA, IDH-mutant, CNS WHO grade 4
- Histological appearance: diffuse astrocytic glioma, showing increased cellularity, nuclear atypia and mitotic activity
- Immunohistochemistry: GFAP positive; IDH1 R132H positive; ATRX lost; p53 overexpressed
- Molecular parameters: IDH1 or IDH2 mutation detected; 1p/19q retained; CDKN2A/B homozygous deletion detected
- CNS WHO grade 4

MGMT promoter methylation testing has been requested; the result will be issued in a supplementary report.
